passkeyOnlyBody: This sign-in needs a stronger check than a code can give. Sign in with your passkey to continue.
noMethodBody: There's no verification method available for this account here. Contact IT and they'll get you back in.
dialogBody: This action needs a fresh verification code before it can go through.
promptTotp: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
promptRecovery: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved when you set this up.
gateVerifyBody: Enter a verification code to continue.
gateVerifyWhy: You're seeing this because this sign-in needed an extra check before continuing.
gateVerifyHelp: No code after a minute? Check your spam folder, or ask IT to help you back in.
gateVerifiedBody: Taking you back to where you left off.
graceBannerBody: Extra security is required for your account by {date}.
gateEnrollBodyBoth: Your account needs an authenticator app and a passkey set up before you can continue.
gateEnrollBodyMfa: Your account needs an authenticator app set up before you can continue.
gateEnrollBodyPasskey: Your account needs a passkey set up before you can continue.
gateEnrollWhy: It takes about two minutes, and you only do it once.
gateEnrollHelp: These protect your account if your password is ever leaked or guessed. Stuck? Ask IT — they can walk you through it.
enrollTotpBody: Scan the code with an app like 1Password, Google Authenticator or Authy, then enter the 6 digits it shows you.
enrollPasskeyBody: Uses the fingerprint, face or PIN you already unlock this device with. Nothing extra to remember.
promptPasskey: Use the fingerprint, face or PIN you unlock this device with.
passkeyError: That passkey didn't go through. Try again, or pick another way.
